description: This PHP file defines metadata configuration for a dashboard widget (dashlet) in the SuiteCRM system. It specifies search fields and display columns for a particular module's dashlet, including configuration for fields like 'date_entered', 'date_modified', 'assigned_user_id', and display columns like 'document_name', 'created_by', and 'assigned_user_name'.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Terminates script execution and outputs a message if an invalid entry point is detected.
